title: Is vertigo a symptom of perimenopause?

top_comments.comment_text:
Yes and it’s scary the first few times. Then you get good at it lol. I may look crazy to the rest of the world, but here’s a few things that work for me:
-if I’m walking and it starts, I choose a line on the floor to follow, or walk near a wall or railing, this helps with balance.
-I try to do a lot of chair stretches while at work. YouTube some. Just gets you out of your head and into your body.
You feel like Youll fall, but you really won’t. So don’t let that first sensation take you into a fight or flight state. 
When you feel it coming on, you know what it is, name it, it will pass. It’s almost a mind over matter. Sometimes it’s easy , sometimes it takes more work.
